_documentation: REFERENCE ONLY. Merge only the applicable keys through protected operator configuration. Blank values are deliberately nonfunctional. Never commit populated secrets.

frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.database: Bench creates per-site db_name/db_password and encryption_key. Back these up securely.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.redis: Bench common_site_config manages redis_cache/redis_queue and any version-specific socket service. Use private networking.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.openai: Encrypted IL SOUL Settings.api_key; configure model, moderation, hosted review, feature credits and model rates via owner services.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.google_login: Frappe Social Login Key (google): client ID, encrypted secret, approved HTTPS redirects.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.email: Frappe Email Account: SMTP host/port/TLS/user/password, sender; configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC externally.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.storage: Default Frappe files; install tested write_file/private-read adapter and its server credentials before switching backend.
frappe_managed_not_manual_defaults.sms_push: Vendor credentials are defined by the selected server adapter; do not invent generic key names or expose them to Vue.
